description: This file declares functions and macros for window creation and management in a Lua binding context, specifically for a graphics/GUI library utilizing GLFW. It includes function prototypes for creating windows, controlling draw loops, setting frame rates, saving screenshots, and global macros for window properties and events.

methods.name: createWindow
methods.description: Creates a GLFW window with specified width, height, and optional rendering mode.

methods.name: noLoop
methods.description: Prevents the 'draw' function from being called repeatedly, effectively pausing the rendering loop.

methods.name: loop
methods.description: Allows the 'draw' function to be called again, resuming the rendering loop.

methods.name: frameRate
methods.description: Sets the frame rate for the rendering loop or returns the current frame rate if called without arguments.

methods.name: saveWindow
methods.description: Saves the current window as an image file, acting as a screenshot.
